title: Full-height NOC rail owns the wheel but not clicks — press/release over the plate falls through to world snap, pan, and click-select
detail: The diff enlarges the owned surface to a 524px full-height plate and routes only the wheel (camera_wheel_policy). With D on, a press over the plate is never swallowed: at zoom>1 it can Begin_Draw from a node hidden under the plate or select hidden entities on release; at the fit it clears the selection via the empty-ground path.
recommended_fix: When overlay_on, hit-test presses/releases against noc_panel_rect (noc_panel_hit) in the ui-press chain and swallow them, so the plate owns clicks like it owns the wheel.

title: Demolish popover clamps to win_w (not play_w) and draws before the rail — hidden under the plate while its demolish button stays clickable
detail: With D on, a selection anchored within ~228px of the rail's left edge places the popover under the alpha-200 plate (drawn later). The banner, settings modal, and upgrade preview were re-anchored to play_w in this diff; the popover was not, so its demolish button is clickable while invisible — an unseen destructive action.
recommended_fix: Clamp popover_rect to the playfield (read v.play_w when the rail is on, like settings_panel_rect) or draw the popover after the rail, and suppress its hit test while covered.
